method: Hand-reviewed annual original Apple descriptions; 2016 uses archived Apple ceremony transcript. No keyword-only coding.

codebook.clarity: Explicitly approachable controls, hierarchy, reduced effort or onboarding.
codebook.platform: Meaningful Apple-device adaptation or named system/tool integration.
codebook.inclusion: Access across disability, language, identity or ability explicitly addressed.
codebook.delight: Playfulness, rewarding feedback, sound or emotional enjoyment.
codebook.visuals: A coherent or unusually crafted visual/animated presentation.
codebook.innovation: A distinct mechanism, new capability or reframed familiar activity.
codebook.impact: An explicit human, social, ecological or community benefit.
codebook.performance: Performance, low latency or graphical adaptability explicitly praised.

relevance_definition: Analyst prioritization: direct includes habits, planning, mindfulness and recurring self-care; adjacent includes enabling utilities, fitness, journaling and everyday workflows; broad and game retained for whole-cohort coverage.
